integrity: The proof uses exact stationary identities and positivity. Numerical recurrence checks corroborate but do not replace the analytic argument. Historical priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Proves an integrated second-moment tail for the infinite critical stationary recurrence only; no pointwise coefficient law, time-dependent convergence, or finite-system dynamics is claimed.
title: Sharp logarithmic finite-cutoff bias at the critical shattering threshold
